name: czl-accounting-close
description: CAS-first accounting close workbench: intake gating, journal entries, reconciliations, three-statement tie-out, variance drill-down and audit hand-over, backed by a runnable stdlib-only CLI.

displayDescription.en: Runs the books end to end: journal entries, reconciliations, the three statements and variance drill-downs, with every gap and data source labelled.
displayDescription.zh: 从接单到归档走完账务闭环：编分录、核对账目、出具三表、拆解差异，缺口与数据来源逐条标清。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 9 月要结账了，我把科目余额表和银行对账单放这儿。帮我排结账顺序，还缺哪些数据直接列给我。
defaultInitPrompt.en: September close is due. I'll drop the trial balance and bank statement here — sequence the close and list whatever data is still missing.

quickPrompts.zh: 9 月要结账了，我把科目余额表和银行对账单放这儿。帮我排结账顺序，还缺哪些数据直接列给我。
quickPrompts.en: September close is due. I'll drop the trial balance and bank statement here — sequence the close and list whatever data is still missing.

quickPrompts.zh: 这笔业务怎么做分录：9 月一次付了 12 个月房租 24 万，收到专票，税率 9%。
quickPrompts.en: How should I book this: 12 months of rent paid up front in September, ¥240,000, VAT special invoice at 9%.

quickPrompts.zh: 9 月收入比 8 月多了 15%，帮我拆成价格、数量、结构三块，说清哪块是主因。
quickPrompts.en: September revenue is up 15% on August. Split it into price, volume and mix, and tell me which one dominates.
